title: Willie Humphrey and his travels
summary: Talk about old Willie Humphrey, who played with the Eagle band for a while but loved to travel and joined a circus band.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Do you remember old man Willie Umphrey? That is not our young man.
I know from Jim Umphrey on down. He was called Willie Umphrey.
Did Willie Umphrey play at the Eagle band whenever you heard him or not?
Because he was supposed to play with him for a while. Well, he played with him for a while. But Willie Umphrey was mostly on the road.
He loved to travel. And the way he traveled, he played around the world until the circus came to town. And he joined the circus band and took the country with him.
He's still living there. We've got to talk to him.
Yeah, he's been sickly for quite a while.
He's in a wheelchair out of trouble. He's trying to hate to bother him, but someday we'll go out and talk to him.
